topic: Modern C++ Random Number Generation with <random>
explanation: In modern C++, the <random> library provides a comprehensive and flexible framework for generating pseudo-random numbers. It introduces a set of standardized components such as random number engines, distributions, and adaptors that enable developers to produce high-quality random values suitable for simulations, statistical sampling, and gaming applications. This approach replaces the older rand() function with a more type-safe, configurable, and extensible system that leverages templates and polymorphism to support various random number generation strategies.
